Seagate is a global leader in mass-capacity data storage, helping organizations and people around the world create, protect, and unlock the value of their data. Analyze, design, implement, debug, and maintain embedded software components in C/C++.
Apply computer science fundamentals to solve product software problems.
Build modular, testable software with clear interfaces, appropriate abstraction, and maintainable structure.

You want to build reliable embedded systems with software that is understandable, testable, extensible, and sustainable.
You are curious about how software interacts with hardware, operating systems, storage architecture, and product behavior.

Strong foundation in core computer science concepts, including operating systems, concurrency, memory management, and computer architecture.
Programming experience in C/C++, Rust, Python or similar languages.
Understanding embedded systems, resource-constrained design, hardware/software interaction, and modern development practices.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technicial field and 0+ years of experience

Experience with embedded operating systems, device drivers, storage systems, real-time software, or low-level platform software.

Knowledge of HDD devices, storage protocols, system-level performance analysis, or storage subsystem topologies.

campus.

About The Role

We are seeking an exceptional individual to dive into the heart of our internal development ecosystem, designing, building, and extending a shared platform that integrates state-of-the-art AI agent technology. Your work will champion extensibility as a core feature, ensuring seamless integration of new triggers, agents, or tools. This dynamic role thrives on navigating ambiguity, understanding that agentic systems are inherently non-deterministic and require empirical, adaptive debugging approaches, offering continuous opportunities for innovation and problem-solving.

What You’ll Be Doing

Architect and implement sophisticated agent orchestration systems, including router functions, queueing mechanisms, and agent invocation services.
Seamlessly integrate AI agent capabilities into modern continuous integration/continuous delivery platforms, designing pipeline configuration patterns where agent invocations execute as stages, process context from code changes, produce artifacts, and control subsequent stages based on AI agent outcomes.
Develop and expand a suite of shared, tool-based functions that empower AI agents with versatile capabilities.
Design and implement advanced knowledge bases, leveraging powerful search and storage technologies to ensure AI agents can reason over a comprehensive, shared organizational context rather than isolated prompts.
Implement robust AI guardrails, including input/output filters, sensitive data scrubbing, content moderation, and fine-grained, per-agent permission boundaries, ensuring secure and compliant AI operations by design.
Develop and integrate resource management controls for efficient resource management, encompassing model tiering and intelligent routing via a large language model gateway, semantic caching, and optimized context-window management.
Instrument the entire AI platform with comprehensive observability, including dashboards, audit trails, and detailed trace logging for every agent invocation (input, output, decision, tokens, cost) to ensure compliance, facilitate debugging, and provide deep operational insights.

Must-Have Qualifications

3–7 years of professional experience in software development.
Strong proficiency in Python and its software development kit for building production-grade serverless functions and event-driven services.
Solid experience with cloud-based services, including serverless compute, application programming interface management, messaging queues, event buses, identity and access management, secrets management, and monitoring tools.
Specific experience with AI agent services, action groups, knowledge bases, and guardrails.
Hands-on experience integrating with large language model application programming interfaces, such as those from leading providers or similar platforms.
Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous delivery platforms and best practices.
A strong security mindset, including expertise in least-privilege access, secure secrets handling, input validation, and an awareness of prompt injection and data-leak risks in large language model workflows.
Comfortable with observability principles, including structured logging, metrics, tracing, and writing highly debuggable code for production environments.

Experience with vector search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation, including vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
Familiarity with financial operations or resource management concepts, such as cost attribution, intelligent model routing, semantic caching, and batch inference.
Experience building developer platforms or internal tooling that other engineers rely on daily.
Familiarity with advanced AI agent frameworks and an understanding of their architectural tradeoffs.

Conduct software testing in lab and shipboard environments to verify performance against system requirements.
Integrate network operating systems, application software, and hardware components into a unified training system.

Experience implementing and testing Graphical User Interfaces (GUI)
Ability to develop and execute task plans independently

Design and implement deep integrations with system-level features, services, and platform APIs to extend AR application capabilities and deliver seamless user experiences.

Mentor and develop other AR Engineers, elevating team capabilities and fostering technical growth.

Strong 3D math and software engineering fundamentals with data structures and algorithms.
Proven ability to build complex technical projects and drive architectural decisions.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills working across Engineering, Design, Product, and Program Management disciplines.
Experience mentoring engineers and elevating team technical capabilities.

Minimum Requirements:

BS / BA degree or equivalent years of experience.
2+ years of experience building real-time 3D interactive applications with any 3D engine / framework (such as C#, Unity, C++, Unreal, JavaScript, TypeScript, Lens Studio, Three.js, Babylon.js, Godot).
Track record of tech leading complex user-facing spatial applications from concept through delivery.
Experience integrating with native/OS services, system-level features, and platform APIs.
Demonstrated ability to build performant real-time applications on resource-constrained devices.

Preferred Requirements:

Demonstrable passion for creating spatial experiences.
Experience using AI as part of your engineering workflow, including how you plan, build, verify, review, and learn, with sound judgment about when and where to leverage it.
Experience defining technical roadmaps and driving cross-functional alignment.
Experience partnering with platform, infrastructure, or systems teams to influence API design and service capabilities.
Understanding of modern UI frameworks and patterns, especially for real-time 3D applications.
Understanding of building real-time applications that interface with external services.
Familiarity with shaders and technical art.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. You’ll design and deliver metadata-driven services, ingestion pipelines, and developer tools that connect catalogs, data stores, and analytics platforms enabling faster insights and stronger governance across critical systems. This is a hands-on role where engineering, data modeling, and collaboration with cross-functional teams converge to deliver measurable impact on national-security-focused solutions.

Must be located in or able to work from Washington, D.C. area (hybrid).
TS/SCI clearance with a current CI polygraph is required; work includes SCIF support.

What You Will Do

Design, implement, and maintain services and tools that integrate with enterprise metadata repositories and data catalogs (ingest, model, search, lineage).
Build and operate metadata ingestion pipelines, RESTful APIs, and event-driven integrations to improve discovery, lineage, and governance.
Create internal developer tooling for schema/metadata management, search, and lineage visualization to accelerate onboarding and data quality.
Define metadata models and integration patterns in partnership with data engineering, product, and platform teams.
Troubleshoot and optimize metadata workflows; monitor data quality and consistency across systems.
Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, sprint planning, and continuous improvement of delivery practices.
Ensure production-ready systems by applying security, performance, and scalability best practices.

What You Need To Have

TS/SCI clearance with CI polygraph (required).
Bachelor’s degree + 6+ years of application/software development experience (or 8+ years’ experience in lieu of a degree); recent hands-on experience within the last 2 years is preferred.
Strong development experience in at least one of: Python, Java, or C#.
Practical experience with metadata stores or governance platforms (examples: Apache Atlas, DataHub, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or similar/custom metadata systems).
Clear understanding of metadata concepts: lineage, schema, glossary, classification, and governance workflows.
Hands-on experience building RESTful APIs and/or event-driven services (Kafka, Pub/Sub, etc.).
Familiarity with cloud platforms and patterns (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Experience with CI/CD, source control (Git), and modern DevOps practices.
Proficiency with Node.js + TypeScript and containerization (Docker).
Experience with search/analytics and data stores such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis.

What We'd Like You To Have

Experience with data engineering, ETL/ELT, or data modeling pipelines.
Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j) or advanced lineage/search capabilities.
Experience with frameworks and tooling like NestJS/Express, Jest, GitLab CI, Spring Boot, or Scala/Groovy.
Background integrating enterprise governance tooling and implementing policy-driven workflows.
Prior work on secure or classified systems (advantageous given mission context).
Interest or experience with applied AI/LLMs for metadata enrichment (e.g., semantic classification, automated tagging).
